title: Hangover-Cure Jiangsu Prunes Dim Sum
description: Resinous, pillowy dim sum from Jiangsu province, featuring prunes and other comforting ingredients to alleviate hangover symptoms. This dish is a unique twist on traditional Chinese cuisine.
instructions: Cut the bok choy into small pieces and set aside.
Mince the garlic and ginger, then mix with soy sauce in a small bowl.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and ginger to the wok and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the prunes to the wok and cook, stirring frequently, until they begin to rehydrate.
Add the bok choy to the wok and cook until it begins to wilt.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and cornstarch until smooth.
Pour the egg mixture into the wok and cook, stirring constantly, until the egg is set.
Season the dim sum with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot.
